cases.summary: Telegram polling not completting when sender has no 'last_name'
cases.description:
Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue.

You should only file an issue if you found a bug. Feature and enhancement requests should go in [the Feature Requests section](https://community.home-assistant.io/c/feature-requests) of our community forum:

**Home Assistant release (`hass --version`):**
0.43.0

**Python release (`python3 --version`):**
The one supplied with the homeassistant docker image

**Component/platform:**
telegram_polling

**Description of problem:**
Telegram polling expects a 'last_name' to be set, if it is not it will not complete the polling job

**Expected:**
Receive the message sent via telegram

**Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` entries and steps to reproduce:**
```yaml

```

1. 
2. 
3. 

**Traceback (if applicable):**
```bash
17-04-24 17:50:39 ERROR (Dummy-14) [homeassistant.core] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "uvloop/future.pyx", line 372, in uvloop.loop.BaseTask._fast_step (uvloop/loop.c:112669)
  File "/usr/src/app/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/polling.py", line 119, in check_incoming
    yield from self.handle()
  File "/usr/src/app/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/polling.py", line 108, in handle
    self.process_message(update)
  File "/usr/src/app/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/__init__.py", line 118, in process_message
    ATTR_FROM_LAST: data['from']['last_name']}
KeyError: 'last_name'

```

**Additional info:**
I have my telegram account for a while now, I'm not sure if this can happen with newer accounts, maybe you are now required to set a `last name`?

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix telegram_polling no first_name or last_name
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix telegram_polling no first_name or last_name

## Description:
This should fix the issue described in #7276. It defaults to 'N/A' for 'last_name' and 'first_name' in telegram messages when either one is not set.

Unfortunately I could not get the indentation right when splitting the line so I just kept them at > 80 chars. Will fix if someone cann explain how I need to indent it...?

commit 16227704d7cfe196d9ef8f3a1b9147368d7773da
Author: Nils Uliczka <nils.uliczka@darookee.net>
Date:   Mon Apr 24 22:08:06 2017 +0200

    Fix telegram_polling no first_name or last_name (#7281)
    
    * Default to 'N/A' if sender has no first_name or last_name
    
    * Fixed as requested

diff --git a/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/__init__.py b/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/__init__.py
index 1cd77491c51..e0adff19731 100644
--- a/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/__init__.py
+++ b/homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/__init__.py
@@ -112,8 +112,8 @@ class BaseTelegramBotEntity:
         event = EVENT_TELEGRAM_COMMAND
         event_data = {
             ATTR_USER_ID: data['from']['id'],
-            ATTR_FROM_FIRST: data['from']['first_name'],
-            ATTR_FROM_LAST: data['from']['last_name']}
+            ATTR_FROM_FIRST: data['from'].get('first_name', 'N/A'),
+            ATTR_FROM_LAST: data['from'].get('last_name', 'N/A')}
 
         if data['text'][0] == '/':
             pieces = data['text'].split(' ')
